subject: Billing handshake: invoice creation, delivery preference, and billing contact
messages:
From: Zencorp Accounts <accounts@zencorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Invoice delivery & billing contact for PO #789

Hi Camila,

Attached is PO #789 for the upcoming monthly credits. Before we get started, AP needs confirmation on a couple of things so we can map your invoices into our system:

- Who should receive the invoice (name + billing email)?
- Do you support portal enrollment / e-invoicing (preferred), or should we expect a PDF emailed to accounts@zencorp.com?
- Please include VAT treatment on the invoice (we are EU-registered but this entity is US-based) — we need the invoice to show the PO and tax fields correctly.

We'd like the first invoice to include the PO number and the remit-to instructions. If you prefer the portal, can you send an enrollment link and any required metadata fields?

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Accounts Payable
Zencorp Inc.

Attachment: Zencorp_PO_789.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Zencorp Accounts <accounts@zencorp.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 16:25:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & billing contact for PO #789

Hi Maya — thanks for the PO and the clear list. Short answers and next steps below: 

1) Delivery options: we support both (a) automatic portal enrollment with structured e-invoices (XML/UBL) and (b) traditional PDF emailed to the billing inbox. Portal enrollment is the recommended path because it allows automated matching by PO and reduces manual reconciliation.

2) Required metadata: to enroll we need the AP email, billing address, remit-to & bank details (we'll send a short form), and whether you need VAT lines (we can include both a VAT summary line and a tax breakdown).

3) Fallback: if you need to go live quickly, we can send the first two invoices by PDF to accounts@zencorp.com while portal enrollment completes (usually 3–5 business days).

Action items I can take now:
- If you confirm portal enrollment, I will send the enrollment link and a sample invoice (XML + human-readable PDF).
- If you prefer email for the first invoice, confirm the billing contact and we’ll send the invoice PDF with PO #789 included.

I've attached a sample invoice XML and PDF layout so your AP team can confirm fields. Connor (cc) is our billing lead and will validate the remit-to formatting for your ERP.

Best,

-- 
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-invoice-sample.xml (XML), sample-invoice.pdf (PDF preview)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 16:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & billing contact for PO #789

Looping in Naomi from Finance to confirm the remit formatting we should provide to Zencorp. Two quick notes: 

- Portal enrollment path: we can push UBL/XML. We require the customer to accept the enrollment form (link Camila will send). Once accepted, our system will start emitting structured invoices that include PO, VAT, and line-level taxes.
- Email fallback: we should include a machine-readable invoice reference line in the PDF (invoice reference: RDW-D-4529) so their AP can map it if they request a PDF first.

Naomi — can you confirm the bank field layout (IBAN vs ACH) we should provide for US entities and whether we need any additional line for VAT when billing a US entity for global customers?

Thanks — Connor
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@zencorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 17:38:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery & billing contact for PO #789

Camila / Connor — thanks for the quick answers. We want to move forward with the PDF email for the first invoice to keep our initial month simple, then enroll in the portal for recurring invoices. Confirming billing contact below so you can send the first invoice PDF: 

Billing contact: 
- Name: Accounts Payable Team
- Email: accounts@zencorp.com
- AP contact (for escalation): Maya Singh <maya.singh@zencorp.com>
- Remit-to: Zencorp Inc., 410 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94104
- VAT status: US entity — please include a zero VAT line and include PO #789 on the line items.

We attached the signed PO to this reply (see attachment). Please send the first invoice PDF to accounts@zencorp.com with invoice reference RDW-D-4529 and the PO shown on each line. After we receive the first PDF and confirm matching, we'll accept the portal enrollment link you send and switch to e-invoice.

Thanks — Maya

Attachment: Zencorp_PO_789_signed.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
